profile.Name: Terron the Steel-bender
profile.Job: Officer of the Skeletons at Rusted Ridge
profile.Personality: Guarded and blunt. He hates the Okranites and brushes off talk of danger as a sign of weakness.
profile.Backstory: He holds Rusted Ridge, the Skeletons' hidden fortress in the mountains of the Wend. He sends talk of alliances to Fuji the Ancient in Black Desert City, or speaks for the Skeletons himself if Fuji has been deposed, and wants Okranites brought to him, above all the High Inquisitors and the Phoenix.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Clipped, suspicious questions that trail into pauses, such as "What is it you want exactly?!"
